node.title: GAINS — Generative AI Impact Net Score diagnostic
node.summary: A diagnostic that benchmarks AI maturity, surfaces organizational friction, and ties AI usage to outcomes.
node.interview_question: Is GAINS a real diagnostic with a defensible scale, or a lead-gen framework? What's the n behind the benchmark?
